description.blurb: S/2004 S 39 is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 39 is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1351.83 days, at an inclination of 167° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.080.
